summary: Q2 FY27 (28 Oct, NSE press release): record revenue Rs 17,103 cr (+44%), EBITDA Rs 2,219 cr (+47%, margin 13.0%), PAT Rs 1,377 cr (+52%). Also a composite scheme (Harita ARC acquisition and a demerger) needing approvals: long-dated, not a near-term event. Trend template 7/7, 4.2% below the 52-week high.
